fact: At the 5 December 2025 launch of the SIVL tax module, the state's Directeur des Systèmes d'Information said the system is hosted in the finance ministry's own datacenters in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire and that his directorate is committed to maintaining it.
title: Le SIVL est un instrument de transformation et un pilier de la performance publique, dixit Okina Elenga-Ngaporo
